<script>
(function () {
  try {
    var srcParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if ([...srcParams.keys()].length === 0) return;

    var links = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="answerthis.io"], a[href*="app.answerthis.io"]');
    links.forEach(function (a) {
      try {
        var url = new URL(a.href, window.location.origin);
        srcParams.forEach(function (v, k) {
          if (!url.searchParams.get(k)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);
        });
        a.href = url.toString();
      } catch (e) {}
    });
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>

(() => {
  if (location.pathname !== "/") return;
  // Let Redux payment-recovery and verification links open on the homepage.
  if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has("rdxlc")) return;

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 1200);

  fetch("https://api.answerthis.io/api/is_logged_in", {
    credentials: "include",
    cache: "no-store",
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
  })
    .then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null))
    .then((session) => {
      if (session?.logged_in) {
        location.replace("https://app.answerthis.io/ask-answerthis");
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {})
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script><!-- SnippetEnd: dKoq_rOac -->

    <!-- Snippet: FJz6JNdHf --><script>
(function () {
  const KEYS = [
    "utm_source",
    "utm_medium",
    "utm_campaign",
    "utm_content",
    "utm_term",
    "campaign_id",
    "adset_id",
    "ad_id",
    "placement",
    "fbclid",
    "funnel_id",
    "experiment_id",
    "variant_id"
  ];

  const incoming = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const attribution = {};

  KEYS.forEach((key) => {
    const value = incoming.get(key);

    if (value) {
      attribution[key] = value;
      localStorage.setItem("at_" + key, value);
    } else {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem("at_" + key);

      if (stored) {
        attribution[key] = stored;
      }
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function (event) {
      const link = event.target.closest("a");

      if (!link || !link.href) return;

      try {
        const url = new URL(link.href);

        const isSignup =
          url.hostname === "app.answerthis.io" &&
          url.pathname.startsWith("/signup");

        if (!isSignup) return;

        Object.entries(attribution).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          if (value && !url.searchParams.has(key)) {
            url.searchParams.set(key, value);
          }
        });

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        window.location.assign(url.toString());
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("AnswerThis attribution error:", e);
      }
    },
    true
  );
})();
</script><!-- SnippetEnd: FJz6JNdHf --><!-- End of bodyEnd -->
